agent_explanation: Single body with e=0.5 falls onto floor (y=0) under gravity. At step 90 body is just above floor (y=0.798, vy=-18.34, energy ~176 J, within bound). At step 91 after floor collision, vy is +28.96 (speed 28.96) instead of expected ~+9 J with e=0.5 restitution (energy-conserving bounce should reduce speed). Energy jumps to 427.2 J, exceeding allowed 198.7 J (E0 176.08 +10%+5). No controller work. Indicates floor impulse/positional-correction bug that injects energy on restitution: bounce velocity magnitude exceeds incoming magnitude despite e<1 and gravity alone cannot explain gain. Counterfactual raising initial height to y=5 avoids floor impact within 91 steps and shows no violation, confirming collision handling is causal.
